content_metadata.description: Join Rex and his dinosaur friends on an exciting journey to learn the alphabet as they explore a mysterious cave and discover a unique dinosaur-themed ABC mural.

youtube_description:
Little dinosaurs came to a cave to explore the ABC mural.
Seems like little dinosaurs are afraid of the dark. Why don't we go inside with Mr. Trevor's beautiful flower lamp?
We'll be able to learn how to read different alphabets and dinosaur names!
You're watching 'Learn ABC with Dinosaurs' , an educational and interactive series prepared to you by Pinkfong!
